svg.title: Deployment architecture
svg.desc: Two release paths: manual infrastructure updates and automatic GitHub-driven website builds.

g.text: Two release paths: manual infrastructure updates and automatic GitHub-driven website builds.
Publish CV and wait for ingestion
The build waits for successful knowledge-base ingestion before publishing the static website.
GitHub pushes rebuild the application; infrastructure YAML changes require a separate CloudFormation deployment.
Source: aws/amplify.yaml + amplify.yml | Official AWS Architecture Icons: July 2026 | Logical service architecture; no VPC
